I had heard good things about this doctor before, so I trusted her. But my delivery experience at Agrawal Hospital was honestly very bad and disappointing.

Throughout my pregnancy, I wasn’t prescribed any iron or multivitamin tablets. just calcium. When I asked for protein powder, they gave me one, but it didn’t help much. I also had other health issues like UTIs, but they were ignored completely.

On 21st May 2024, during my check-up, I told the doctor that I felt like my water was leaking, and that the flow seemed more than normal. But she didn’t ask for any scan or sonography.

Then on the night of 23rd May, I could barely feel my baby move. I panicked and got a sonography done on 24th May on my own, without the doctor’s advice. The report showed my amniotic fluid was low just 8%, which should ideally be at least 11%. Within 2 hours, I repeated the scan at another diagnostic center, and it had dropped to 7%.

I rushed back to show both reports to the doctor. But she said, “Don’t worry. Just eat vitamin C fruits and drink water. Come for your next check-up on 6th June.” My due date was 13th June.

The moment I reached home, my clothes were wet again. That’s when my husband rushed me to the hospital and told the doctor firmly: “If anything happens to the baby or mother, we will not sit quietly." Only then she asked for another scan. That scan showed my fluid was now 5.5%, my baby had very little movement and was in an uncomfortable, curled-up position.

Finally, at around 4:30 PM, she did the surgery.

The hospital bill was around ₹1.40 lakhs, plus ₹15,000 extra for all medicines and operation-related items that we had to buy ourselves. Nothing was provided by the hospital.
